text:
ashley: heads-up: i'm kicking off a focused spike to reduce long-lived CP <-> tenant VPC tunnels. goal: narrow handshake surface, make fallbacks explicit, and avoid global peering proliferation. posting quick plan.
maria: +1. are we making ephemeral handshakes the default for new tenants?

dashley: yes for new low-risk tenants: ephemeral bootstrap mTLS on demand, prefer agentless private endpoint when available. keep peering/persistent-relay as opt-in for regulated/legacy customers.
dong: auth flow? CSR, short certs, or tokens? where does KMS come in?

ashley: CSR -> KMS-signed certs. proposal: bootstrap cert TTL 5-15m, agent-managed certs auto-renew at 7d, tokens only for relay fallback with revocation hooks.

kevin: define guardrails: key SLIs = handshake p95, fallback-to-relay rate, cert-issuance latency, and CP CPU per-handshake. alert if fallback-rate > 0.4% over 5m.
sam: ops: need per-tenant force-relay toggle, bulk view of tenants in ephemeral mode, and runbook for rollback during canary.
maria: DNS is tricky; ephemeral endpoints might be cached. suggestion: ephemeral subdomain + low TTL with SDKs honoring TTL and exposing refresh hooks.

ashley: agreed. DNS plan: initial TTL=3s for first 2m, then 30s once stable. SDKs should avoid local caching for critical control calls.
dong: handshake storms if many agents restart. mitigation?

ashley: regional jittered backoff, leader election to batch renewals, and short reuse window (reuse cert for N requests within TTL). rate-limit KMS signing requests.

kevin: add NAT observability: SYN reset rate, source-port churn, and ephemeral connection counts. include NAT-flap test in spike.
sam: rollout: alpha internal -> beta opt-in -> canary 0.5% traffic -> ramp. auto-rollback if fallback-rate > 0.4% or TLS p95 > 200ms.
maria: policy snippet we can show to apps?

ashley: quick example for discussion:

```
handshake_strategy: ephemeral_csr
bootstrap_ttl_s: 600
reuse_requests: 8
batch_renew_jitter_ms: 20000
cert_issuer: redwood-kms
fallback:
  relay_on_failure: true
  relay_backoff_s: 600
  fallback_triggers: [tls_errors>5, dns_failures>3]
```

kevin: runtime flag to force-relay per-tenant for debugging. also log an audit event for every cert issuance (tenant, reason, signer).
dong: security review items: SAN must bind to tenant id and allowed CIDR, CSR origin authenticated, HSM-backed signer, observable revocation.
sam: infra-bot: scheduling spike env deploy now.

infra-bot: deploy started: infra/spike/ephemeral-handshake -> us-east-1/spike-07.

maria: can we add a k6 scenario that simulates 5k short-lived connections to measure handshake CPU and fallback events?

ashley: will add k6 test and post graphs in this thread after first run (ts: 3661234890). action items: 1) implement CSR signer + short cert flow (ashley) 2) batch/leader renew design (dong) 3) metrics/dashboard + alerts (kevin) 4) per-tenant toggle + runbook (sam) 5) security checklist + audit events (maria).
